water_context.title: Water use and data-centre planning
water_context.scope: National framework — England and Wales; not a site assessment
water_context.summary: The Environment Agency explains that cooling choices and location matter for water demand. It identifies gaps in data-centre water-use information and calls for demand to be considered in regional water planning.
water_context.claim_limit: This does not identify this site's supplier, water use, cooling technology, local water pressure or permission to abstract water.
water_context.source_label: Environment Agency — water for data centres, section 9.4
